basic.name: Frost Thorn
basic.description_template: Deals Ice DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Yanqing's ATK to a single enemy.

skill.name: Darting Ironthorn
skill.description_template: Deals Ice DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Yanqing's ATK to a single enemy and activates Soulsteel Sync for 1 turn.

ultimate.name: Amidst the Raining Bliss
ultimate.description_template: Increases Yanqing's CRIT Rate by 60%. When Soulsteel Sync is active, increases Yanqing's CRIT DMG by an extra {{crit_dmg}}%. This buff lasts for one turn. Afterwards, deals Ice DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Yanqing's ATK to a single enemy.

talent.name: One With the Sword
talent.description_template: When Soulsteel Sync is active, Yanqing is less likely to be attacked by enemies. Yanqing's CRIT Rate increases by {{crit_rate}}% and his CRIT DMG increases by {{crit_dmg}}%. After Yanqing attacks an enemy, there is a {{fua_chance}}% fixed chance to launch Follow-up ATK, dealing Ice DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Yanqing's ATK to the enemy, which has a 65% base chance to Freeze the enemy for 1 turn. The Frozen target cannot take action and receives Ice Additional DMG equal to {{add_damage}}% of Yanqing's ATK at the beginning of each turn. When Yanqing receives DMG, the Soulsteel Sync effect will disappear.

technique.name: The One True Sword
technique.description: After using his Technique, at the start of the next battle, Yanqing deals 30% more DMG for 2 turn(s) to enemies whose current HP percentage is 50% or higher.

2.name: Icing on the Kick
2.description: After Yanqing attacks, deals Ice Additional DMG equal to 30% of Yanqing's ATK to enemies with Ice Weakness.

4.name: Frost Favors the Brave
4.description: When Soulsteel Sync is active, Effect RES increases by 20%.

6.name: Gentle Blade
6.description: When a CRIT Hit is triggered, increases SPD by 10% for 2 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Svelte Saber
eidolons.description: When Yanqing attacks a Frozen enemy, he deals Ice Additional DMG equal to 60% of his ATK.

eidolons.name: Supine Serenade
eidolons.description: When Soulsteel Sync is active, Energy Regeneration Rate increases by an extra 10%.

eidolons.name: Sword Savant
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Searing Sting
eidolons.description: When the current HP percentage is 80% or higher, this unit's Ice RES PEN increases by 12%.

eidolons.name: Surging Strife
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Swift Swoop
eidolons.description: If the buffs from "Soulsteel Sync" or the Ultimate are in effect when an enemy is defeated, the duration of these buffs is extended by 1 turn.
